# Epigram

> Epigram is an open-source, AI-summarized personalized news reader built with Next.js.

Epigram fetches stories from Mediastack and Exa, summarizes them with OpenAI
gpt-4o-mini via the Vercel AI SDK, and presents a fast, topic-organized reading
feed. The UI is responsive and swipeable, with PWA-style add-to-home-screen
support.

## Topics

Users can browse a personalized feed organized by topics at `/topics`.

## AI Insights

In addition to default story summaries, an optional deeper AI analysis is
available for individual stories via `/api/news/ai-insights`.

## News Ingestion

News ingestion runs through the cron-triggered `/api/news/populate` endpoint,
which requires a secret header and caches fetched results in Upstash Redis for
fast feed delivery.

## Tech Stack

- Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19
- Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, Framer Motion, vaul
- Vercel AI SDK with OpenAI gpt-4o-mini
- Upstash Redis for caching, rate limiting
- Mediastack and Exa as news sources

Note: this is a placeholder (dummy) llms-full.txt intended for future
expansion with real, curated documentation for LLM consumption.
